idiom.title: Up for grabs
idiom.glossZh: “人人可得” 或 “人人都有机会”。
idiom.interpretationEn: This idiom originated in the early 20th century, implying that something is available for anyone to claim. You can understand it as prizes, opportunities, or items that don’t have a fixed owner and are available for anyone to take.
idiom.interpretationZh: 这个成语起源于 20 世纪初期，意指某物可以供大家争夺。我们可以将它理解为某些奖品、机会、或物品没有固定的拥有者，任何人都有机会获得。

examples.en: The tickets to the concert are up for grabs, so act fast!
examples.zh: 音乐会的门票人人可得，所以动作要快！

examples.en: With the manager retiring, the position is up for grabs.
examples.zh: 经理退休了，这个职位人人都有机会。

examples.en: There’s a scholarship up for grabs for the best essay.
examples.zh: 有一个奖学金供最佳文章竞争。

people.name: Ammo Baba
people.extract: Emmanuel Baba Dawud, better known as Ammo Baba, was an Iraqi football player and coach of the Iraq national football team.

people.name: Lyle Mays
people.extract: Lyle David Mays was an American jazz pianist, composer, and member of the Pat Metheny Group. Metheny and Mays composed and arranged nearly all of the group's music, for which Mays won eleven Grammy Awards.
highlights: Member of the Pat Metheny Group.

people.name: Increase Sumner
people.extract: Increase Sumner was an American lawyer, jurist, and politician from Massachusetts. He was the fifth governor of Massachusetts, serving from 1797 to 1799. Trained as a lawyer, he served in the provisional government of Massachusetts during the American Revolutionary War, and was elected to the Confederation Congress in 1782. Appointed to the Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court the same year, he served there as an associate justice until 1797.
highlights: Served in provisional government during American Revolutionary War.
Associate justice of Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court.
